kind: Development-only pre-reply human-policy mass over all damage-preserving legal replies
sampling: 100 mistake rows per archive (or CLI count), seed 1701; sampled from all canonical rows without reading actual opponent replies or future outcomes. Month-balanced pilot, not a population-weighted prevalence estimate.
event: (historical win_before - Stockfish19 winning chance after candidate reply) / historical initial_damage >= 0.75, from original mistake-maker perspective
probability: Sum frozen Maia-2 full-precision legal-move probabilities over ALL legal replies satisfying the event. No top-k truncation, no residual unscored mass.
routing: Released Blitz for Blitz/Bullet, Rapid for Rapid/Classical/Correspondence; otherwise initial+40*increment <480 -> Blitz. All non-Blitz/Rapid domains flagged.
clocks: Policy does not condition on live clocks. Opponent pre-reply clock is metadata only.
external_pretraining_caveat: 2019-02 may overlap model pretraining; raw/calibrated results for the four earlier archives are reported separately. This is a documented-date check, not an independently verified training-game membership audit. External model training players are not guaranteed disjoint from evaluation players.
engine_cache_policy: Read-only reuse of existing exact-FEN Stockfish19 depth18 evaluations; remaining unique children use the same binary/settings at depth18. New search processes retain TT within 32-position batches, matching the legacy warm-cache approach. Only the NEW output cache is written.
evaluation: Actual reply/results read only AFTER all pre-reply predictions are saved. Reuse original game outer assignments. Fixed sigmoid probability calibration fits only other outer-training games, with player purge in the player protocol. No Optuna, classification cutoff selection or primary-model changes.
calibration: LogisticRegression C=1, logit(raw policy mass), training-only; known probability endpoints 0 and 1 preserved exactly.
bootstrap: Paired percentile game-cluster intervals on saved OOF probability errors, conditional on fixed folds/model. No refitting within bootstrap.
limitations: The probability is an estimate from a human-move model, not ground-truth human behavior.
Exact aggregation means every legal move is scored under the defined depth18 procedure; Stockfish estimates themselves are finite-search approximations.
Damage denominator and win_before come from historical engine evaluations of unrecorded version.
Maia-2 rating bins collapse ratings below 1100 and at/above 2000; no clock conditioning.
Bullet, classical, correspondence, low clocks and early plies can be outside training domain.
FEN reconstruction cannot recover earlier repetition history; PGN outcomes are not used to fill missing opponent replies. Primary horizon targets remain unchanged.
